title: Crème Brûlée
description: A barely set vanilla custard, chilled, then topped with a sheet of caramelised sugar that cracks under the spoon.
notes: The custards keep three days covered in the fridge. Caramelise only just before serving.

steps.text: Heat the cream with the vanilla pod and its seeds until steaming, then leave to infuse off the heat.
Whisk the egg yolks with the caster sugar just to combine, then pour in the hot cream slowly, stirring.
steps.tip: Stir, do not whisk hard — foam on the custard bakes into a pitted surface.

steps.text: Strain into six ramekins, set them in a roasting tin, and pour boiling water halfway up their sides. Bake until set at the edges with a wobble in the middle.
Cool, then refrigerate until cold through.
Just before serving, sprinkle each with a teaspoon of demerara sugar and caramelise with a blowtorch until deep amber.
steps.tip: Let it sit a minute to harden. The grill works, but it warms the custard underneath.
